title: Positive: Good input validation on link_etx and rank
description:
## Locations
- Line 324-326: ETX validation (`is_finite()` and `>= 1.0`)
- Line 170-176: path_cost handles NaN/negative, saturates correctly
- Line 99-101: candidate_admissible guards against division by zero
- Line 413: admissible() rejects ranks below min_hop_rank_increase

## Why this is worth defending
These validations prevent:
- NaN/infinity propagation through rank calculations
- Division by zero panics
- Invalid RPL states from malformed DIOs

Input validation is at the correct boundary (process_dio entry) and consistently applied.
